paper.title_en: Hydrodynamic description of correlation matrix eigenvalues in a finite temperature expanding free fermionic gas
paper.abstract_en: A recent work considered the Page curve for entanglement entropy of a freely expanding one-dimensional Fermi gas starting from a finite box (the system) in a zero-temperature initial state that then expands in to a semi-infinite vacuum (the environment). For the case with a single defect at the system-environment junction, it was shown that the Yang-Yang entropy of the system computed from semiclassical hydrodynamics agrees with the microscopically computed entanglement entropy, yielding the Page curve. On the other hand, the environment Yang-Yang entropy showed a monotonic increase. Here, we propose a hydrodynamic description to obtain the eigenvalues of the microscopic correlation matrix for a nonzero temperature freely-expanding Fermi gas. For the system, the phase space density directly gives the correlation matrix eigenvalues and thus, via the Yang-Yang formula, yields the von-Neumann entropy. For the reservoir, a modification of the phase space density is required in the Yang-Yang formula, to incorporate coherences, in order to reproduce accurately the entropy. The hydrodynamic description of correlation matrix eigenvalues also leads to a Levitov-Lesovik type formula for the full-counting-statistics for a finite system in the transient regime. We provide a heuristic derivation of the correlation matrix eigenvalues based on a semiclassical wave-packet picture.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出有限温度膨胀自由费米子气中关联矩阵本征值的水动力学描述，并以半经典波包图像给出启发式推导，涉及Page曲线与Yang-Yang熵，与全息纠缠熵主题相关，理论深度尚可，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 有限温度膨胀自由费米子气中关联矩阵本征值的水动力学描述
decision.abstract_zh: 近期一项工作考虑了从有限盒子（系统）出发、初始为零温态继而膨胀进入半无限真空（环境）的一维自由膨胀费米子气的纠缠熵的Page曲线。对于系统与环境交界处存在单个缺陷的情形，已证明由半经典水动力学计算得到的系统Yang-Yang熵与微观计算的纠缠熵一致，从而给出Page曲线。另一方面，环境的Yang-Yang熵则呈现单调增加。本文提出一种水动力学描述，用以获得非零温度自由膨胀费米子气的微观关联矩阵的本征值。对于系统，相空间密度直接给出关联矩阵本征值，并由此通过Yang-Yang公式得到冯·诺依曼熵。对于储层，需要对Yang-Yang公式中的相空间密度加以修正，以纳入相干性，从而准确重现熵。关联矩阵本征值的这一水动力学描述还导出了有限系统在瞬态下的全计数统计的一个Levitov-Lesovik型公式。我们基于半经典波包图像给出关联矩阵本征值的一个启发式推导。
